$comment: Figma layer path (as in spec.json) -> element inside the entry's target (.ds-alert) and how to read it. skip: spec keys not compared for this layer.

root.$why: The border is outside the box in Figma, drawn as an outer 1 px shadow. Figma nests the padding and gap in a 'content' frame; in code they are on the root, checked under 'content'.

content.$why: The alert itself: code has no inner content wrapper.

body.$why: The body takes the room the action leaves; the action button hugs its label, whose width follows glyph rasterisation.

action.$why: Hugs the button, whose width follows the label's glyph rasterisation.
